name: bridge-contract-tests
description: Static type-check of the shipped tiro-swm-bridge.js against the @tiro-health/web-sdk (<tiro-form-filler>) frontend contract. The SDK is intentionally NOT a dependency here: CI installs the exact version pinned in build/web-sdk/package.json — the version the harness embeds and ships (GH-59/GH-60). The nightly run installs @latest instead, as an advisory heads-up for the next pin bump.
